fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.help: The address or acreage, as it should appear on the listing card, like "42.7 Acres – Hwy 114".

fields.name: date
fields.label: Date listed
fields.help: Listings show newest first. Change it to move a property up or down its list.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.help: Sold properties show on the Sold page for their year, and on the home page in the newest year.

fields.name: soldYear
fields.label: Year sold
fields.help: Only for sold properties. Puts it on that year's Sold page, such as 2026.

fields.name: underContract
fields.label: Under contract
fields.help: Adds the gold "Under Contract" ribbon to an available property's photo.

fields.name: hunting
fields.label: Hunting & Recreational Ranches
fields.help: Tick every section the property belongs in. It can be in more than one.

fields.name: price
fields.label: Price
fields.help: Exactly as it should show, like "$542,290" or "$7,250".

fields.name: size
fields.label: Size
fields.help: Optional, like "42.7 Acres". Shows as "Size: 42.7 Acres" under the price.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Cover photo
fields.help: The photo on the listing card and the first one in the gallery.

fields.name: photos
fields.label: Gallery photos
fields.help: Shown after the cover photo, in the order they were added.

fields.name: features
fields.label: Property features
fields.help: Short points such as "Barn" or "Close To 2 Lakes". Each shows on its own line.

fields.name: map
fields.label: Map location
fields.help: Latitude and longitude from Google Maps, like "33.2033,-98.1888", or a street address. Leave blank for no map.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Search description
fields.help: What Google shows under the link. Left blank, the start of the summary is used.
